h2: An established family company you can trust
intro: MrPaint is a local, family-run painting company that has been delivering quality finishes for over a decade. Founded by Adrian Tucci in 2014, MrPaint has built a reputation for superior workmanship, fair pricing and genuine local service.
paragraphs: A hands-on businessman with 20+ years of painting experience, Adrian Tucci founded MrPaint with a simple philosophy: customer focus, superior workmanship, affordability and professionalism.

We deliver everything from the simplest painting tasks to complex and intricate special finishes. Every project — irrespective of size or budget — gets the same hassle-free service from quoting through to completion.

Specialising in residential, commercial and strata, MrPaint takes on a broad spectrum of work — from simple repaints to the kind of elaborate special-finish projects only experienced master craftsmen can deliver.
Our client list includes award-winning builders, boutique agents and Australian corporate companies. We partner with each client to understand the vision and deliver against it.
At the start of 2024 we relocated the family to Cairns and are now exclusively serving the good people of Cairns and surrounds. We couldn't be happier with the move.
MrPaint is fully insured and Work, Health and Safety compliant.

pillars.title: Certified experts
pillars.body: At the core of MrPaint is a team of experienced, qualified tradesmen — most of whom learned their craft in Europe. There is no goal out of reach for our clients.

pillars.title: Quality services
pillars.body: MrPaint always aims to exceed client expectations by delivering a better finish, on time, at a competitive price. We assign a supervisor who reports directly to the business owner to ensure our quality standards. We only use the best quality paints available.

pillars.title: Affordable pricing
pillars.body: We have structures in place to meet most budget requirements. Speak to Adrian today about your painting project and we'll work out an honest, competitive price.
